title: Junior Frontend-utvecklare
description:
Om Faverli Faverli är en svensk startup som grundades vid Stockholms universitet. Vi bygger en app som hjälper studenter och nyexaminerade att hitta och få sitt första jobb, och vi gör det som studenter själva. I appen finns Faverli Buddy, vår AI-assistent som skickar jobbtips som matchar varje användare. Arbetsgivare använder Faverli för att nå unga talanger.
  
  

Vi är ett litet team i tidig fas med höga ambitioner. Under 2026 är vi semifinalister i BLINGs tävling För-orten. Om tjänsten Vi söker en junior frontendutvecklare som vill vara med och forma en produkt som tusentals studenter ska använda. Du jobbar nära grundarteamet och design, och det du bygger når användarna snabbt.
  
  

Hos oss får du stort ansvar tidigt och lär dig mycket på kort tid. Arbetsuppgifter Du bygger och vidareutvecklar gränssnitt i vår app och på webben, bland annat för profiler, jobbmatchning och prenumerationer. Du gör om designskisser till responsiva och tillgängliga komponenter. Du kopplar frontend till våra API: er tillsammans med backend.
  
  

Du deltar i kodgranskning, testning och löpande förbättringar baserat på feedback från användarna. Requirements Vi söker dig som har en avslutad eller pågående utbildning inom systemvetenskap, datavetenskap, frontendutveckling eller liknande, eller motsvarande kunskaper genom egna projekt har grundläggande erfarenhet av HTML, CSS och JavaScript/TypeScript kan använda Git kommunicerar obehindrat på svenska och/eller engelska Meriterande Erfarenhet av mobilutveckling Intresse för UX och design, gärna med erfarenhet av Figma Egna projekt eller en portfolio som du kan visa upp Erfarenhet av startupmiljö Som person är du nyfiken och driven, och du gillar att ta egna initiativ. Du trivs med att saker går fort och att planerna ibland ändras. Vi erbjuder En central roll i ett växande bolag med möjlighet att påverka produkten på riktigt Snabb utveckling och nära samarbete med grundarna Ett ungt team med fokus på studenters framtid Contact Omar Ahmed omar.ahmed@faverli.com

title: Junior Fullstackutvecklare
description:
Är du i början av karriären, har hobbyprojekt och ett stort intresse för fullstackutveckling? I den här rollen får du arbeta med både backend och frontend i en produkt med flera integrationer och funktioner där bolaget utvecklar ett affärssystem som används genom hela kundens arbetsflöde. Vi söker dig som har kommit igång med C# och .NET samt TypeScript och HTML, genom arbete eller egna projekt, och som vill fortsätta sin utvecklingsresa. OM TJÄNSTEN Du blir en del av ett utvecklingsteam med 12 utvecklare, där du utgår från kontoret här i Göteborg.
  
  

Teamet består blandade erfarenhetsnivår med mycket erfarenhet vilket innebär att man här får möjligheten att lära sig av duktiga och erfarna kollegor. Du får en ordentlig introduktion och en mentor som stöttar dig när du lär känna produkten, koden och arbetssätten, men det förutsätter även att du har viss erfarenhet av området sedan tidigare. Systemet innehåller flera delar som behöver fungera tillsammans och kopplas även ihop med externa tjänster. Det ger dig möjlighet att förstå hur olika delar av en produkt hänger samman och hur dina lösningar används i praktiken.
  
  

Idag används AI som stöd i utvecklingsarbetet, där dem ser positivt på framtida utvecklingsområden inom AI så om man även har ett intresse för detta så är det ett stort plus. Du har möjlighet att till stor del kunna påverka dina arbetstider där de utgår från ett hybridupplägg med minst två dagar i veckan på kontoret och möjlighet att arbeta hemifrån övriga dagar. ARBETSUPPGIFTER Utveckla och vidareutveckla funktioner i backend med C# och .NET Arbeta med användargränssnitt i TypeScript och HTML Felsöka och förbättra funktioner i en befintlig produkt Samarbeta med utvecklare och andra kollegor för att förstå behov och ta fram lösningar Sätta dig in i hur produktens olika delar och integrationer fungerar tillsammans VI SÖKER DIG SOM Har en eftergymnasial utbildning, ex. en YH eller kandidatexamen, inom programmering eller motsvarande område Har praktisk erfarenhet av backendprogrammering i C# och .NET Har praktisk erfarenhet av frontendprogrammering i TypeScript och HTML Har fått erfarenheten genom arbete eller egna hobbyprojekt Stor vikt kommer läggas på personliga egenskaper där vi ser att du är nyfiken, tycker om att lära dig och vågar testa dig fram.
  
  

Du frågar när något är oklart och trivs med att lösa problem tillsammans med andra. ÖVRIG INFORMATION Omfattning: Heltid Start: Så snart som möjligt, med hänsyn till eventuell uppsägningstid Placering: Göteborg. Rekryteringsansvarig: Disa Hedin Ansök genom att klicka på länken nedan. Vi gör löpande urval och annonsen kan stängas innan tjänsten är tillsatt.
  
  

OM ANSTÄLLNINGEN Detta är ett konsultuppdrag där du initialt blir anställd av Friday. Ambitionen är att du efter cirka 12 månader går över till en anställning hos kunden. OM FRIDAY På Friday brinner vi för att ge dig som Tech-talang en riktigt bra start på karriären. Genom att lyssna på vad just du vill och drivs av matchar vi dig med företag och möjligheter som får dig att se fram emot att gå till jobbet.
  
  

Vi värderar ambition och potential högt och arbetar aktivt för en fördomsfri rekrytering där alla ges samma möjlighet att lyckas. Vi finns i Stockholm, Göteborg, Malmö, Linköping och Örebro. Varje år genomför vi över 5 000 karriärmöten och matchar kandidater med allt från globala företag till innovativa startups.

title: Production Developer
description:
Sweden Manufacturing Support 2 - 5 years Skövde On-site
Skaraborg is in an exciting phase of development with significant investments and new projects at several leading industrial companies. To meet the demand, we at TMC in Skövde are now seeking more Employeneurs who want to help shape the future of production.

  


About The Member Company
We are a global high-tech consultancy company with a team of entrepreneurial engineers, scientists, and digital experts from around the world. Together we form a fast-growing and proud community. We offer consultancy services to high-profile clients globally in diverse service areas, such as:


* Technology & Engineering
* Energy & Renewables
* Life sciences & Pharma
* Digital & IT
**About this vacancy**
----------------------


In the role of a production developer, you help our clients develop and improve their production. Broadly speaking, you will work with production development, industrialization, efficiency improvements, and new production solutions. The projects vary depending on the business and may be within the automotive industry, process industry, food industry, or other manufacturing industries.


Tasks may include project management, industrialization, machinery procurement and investments, workplace design, risk analysis, process development, flow development, material handling, SAT/FAT, and production efficiency improvement. Our projects range from specialist efforts in specific areas to larger development and investment projects where we collaborate with our clients to develop and improve their operations.


We are looking for someone with experience in production environments and some form of production process, such as assembly, machining, process production, or other manufacturing activities. Experience in MTM SAM, flow simulation, improvement work, ergonomics, or production development is advantageous.


**What we expect from you**
---------------------------


* An academic degree in mechanical engineering, production technology, or a similar field.
* Experience of working for a few years as a production engineer or in a similar technical role within production.
* Experience with production environments and at least one production process, such as assembly, machining, or process production.
* Strong communication skills.
* Proficiency in Swedish and English, fluent in both spoken and written communication.
**What you can expect from us**
-------------------------------


In the role of Employeneur, you get to both develop your technical skills and drive your own development and business. We place great emphasis on your personal commitment and your willingness to drive your development forward. To succeed in this, you are given the opportunity to influence the type of projects you take on as well as the professional development you want to invest in. You steer your career, quite simply.


Since TMC is an international company, we can offer projects in various locations across different countries where we and our clients are present. Currently, we are represented in Sweden, the Netherlands, Belgium, France, Luxembourg, Spain, Portugal, Italy, Hungary, U.A.E., USA, and Canada. You get the world as your workplace! #LI-LM4


**The 5 basic principles of employeneurship**
---------------------------------------------


As pioneers in employeneurship, we have redefined the traditional work model. We offer our employeneurs the opportunity to combine the security of a permanent contract with their passion for entrepreneurship.


A long-term working relationship


Enjoy the security of a long-term contract and a stable source of income while getting the opportunity to work at diverse projects.


Individual profit sharing


Full transparency. That’s it. For each of your projects, you know your hourly rate, your costs, and your individual performance-based profit sharing, all in order to stimulate your inner entrepreneur.


Business cells


Our employeneurs are grouped in business cells based on their technical expertise. They are small, focused and function as high-grade knowledge networks. And as buzzing communities of close colleagues.


YOUniversity


Every employeneur drives their own career. Together, we make a plan for personal and professional growth. Receive personal coaching and an extensive training budget to keep developing yourself and deliver outperformance at our clients.


The Entrepreneurial Lab


Work on your technical ambitions within our Entrepreneurial Lab (TEL). Here, you are given the space to explore ideas, experiment, and develop them into tangible solutions. In multidisciplinary teams, you collaborate with colleagues from different fields, bringing in new perspectives and accelerating innovation. The lab not only provides access to knowledge and resources, but also encourages ownership. This allows you to develop not only your technical expertise, but also your entrepreneurial skills, enabling you to actively contribute to solutions that truly make a difference.
company_description: At TMC we believe it's people who drive technology. Our Employeneurship model creates the best conditions for technical talents to do so.

title: Fullstack utvecklare
description:
Vill du utveckla plattformar som skapar konkret kundvärde? Vi söker en erfaren fullstackutvecklare med gedigna kunskaper i PHP, Laravel och React som vill vara med och bygga nästa kapitel för Våning 18. Våning 18 är en performance marketing-byrå med närmare 50 medarbetare och kontor i Halmstad och Göteborg. Sedan starten 2016 har vi byggt en verksamhet med över 70 miljoner kronor i omsättning och stabil lönsamhet.
  
  

Vi är Google Premier Partner och sedan 2022 en del av Lyvia Group. Nu tar vi nästa steg. Vi utvecklas från en traditionell byråverksamhet till en byrå där egenutvecklade plattformar, AI och automation blir en allt viktigare del av vårt erbjudande. Genom att kombinera vår kompetens inom digital marknadsföring med egen teknik vill vi skapa större kundvärde och effektivare leveranser.
  
  

Som fullstackutvecklare förvaltar och vidareutvecklar du våra egenutvecklade plattformar, både i backend och i gränssnitten som kunder och kollegor använder. Du säkerställer att befintlig funktionalitet fungerar stabilt och utvecklar nya funktioner och integrationer utifrån verksamhetens och kundernas behov. Du samarbetar med våra övriga utvecklare och specialister inom digital marknadsföring. Du får stort utrymme att bidra med din erfarenhet, föreslå förbättringar och påverka hur vi bygger våra lösningar.
  
  

En central del av arbetet är vår egenutvecklade plattform Doost. Den är byggd i PHP/Laravel med Inertia.js och React, med MySQL som databas. Vi använder Laravel Forge för drifthantering och AWS för lagring. title: Full-Stack Developer Diagnostic Platform
description:
TRATON is a group of strong brands with a shared mission: transforming transportation together to create the future of sustainable transport solutions. Within TRATON, we include MAN, Scania, Volkswagen Truck & Bus, and International. As part of a global team of industry experts, you get to think bigger, experience more, and reach further. Together, we have the power to transform transportation - Let´s make a difference together. Find out more: www.traton.com  

  



Our values – customer first, respect, team spirit, responsibility, and elimination of waste – are at the heart of everything we do.


**Role Summary**
----------------

  

*This role is a part of TRATON Group R&D, located in Södertälje, Sweden*

  

As a Full-Stack developer within the Diagnostic Platform, you will be part of cross-functional teams working to design and develop the next generation of tools for distributing software to vehicles. You will be working closely with other teams located in Sweden, Germany and the US.


The role places great emphasis on your communication skills and your ability to independently take responsibility and identify needs.


**Job Responsibilities**
------------------------

  

* Work and in agile teams and contribute to both the team and your own development.
* Collaborate within a cross-functional, agile product team.
* Design client-side and server-side architecture using .NET, C#, C++, Angular/React, JQuery, Html/CSS
* Build and manage AWS infrastructure.
* Improve monitoring, logging, and observability to ensure system reliability and performance.
* Participate in architectural discussions and technical planning.
**Who You Are**
---------------

  

* University degree or equivalent experience.
* 5+ years of software development experience.
* Independently working with a high sense of ownership of the product.
* Experienced in dotnet .NET or equivalent.
* Experienced in Frontend Interfaces.
* Experienced in Backend APIs and Services development.
* Experience working with AWS.
* Strong communication skills and a collaborative attitude.

Nice to have:


* Experience in Vehicle Diagnostics.
* Experience with setting up monitoring/observability tooling (e.g., OpenTelemetry, Grafana, Prometheus).
**This Is Us**
--------------

  

The Diagnostic Platform is responsible for creating and supporting services for distributing vehicle software. our customers are both production and aftermarket.


We believe in teamwork, knowledge sharing, and collaboration across borders and functions. With curiosity and a continuous improvement mindset, we work together to develop solutions that make a real difference for our customers and for our future.

  

*Within TRATON Group R&D, you are an important part of something bigger. Joining us means gaining access to the ins and outs of the entire transportation industry.*


**TRATON Offers**
-----------------

  

We offer a dynamic and engaging workplace where collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement are part of everyday life. You will be part of a strong team environment that encourages knowledge sharing and close cooperation across functions.

  

With a structured development plan and a wide range of training opportunities, TRATON Group R&D supports your professional growth both locally and internationally.

  

Benefits include access to our health center in Gröndal or a wellness allowance, bonus, flexible working hours, and company car leasing. We also arrange events for employees and their families, and for those living in Stockholm, convenient commuting is supported through direct Scania Job express buses to Södertälje.


**Application**
---------------

We look forward to receiving your application, consisting of your CV and kindly ask you not to share a cover letter to ensure an efficient and unbiased recruitment process for all parties.  

  



Apply as soon as possible, no later than 2026-12-07. Screening will take place on an ongoing basis during the application period. Logical and personality tests may be used as part of the selection process, and a background check may be required for this role.  

  



**If you have questions or would like more information, please contact:**
  

Gylling Kenneth, Manager, kenneth.gylling@scania.com

  

  

**We look forward to your application!**

title: Javautvecklare till Försäkringskassan, Östersund
description:
Placeringsort
Flera orter
Diarienummer
FK 2026/035897  



*Varje år fattar Försäkringskassan 21 miljoner beslut som påverkar människors liv och hela samhället. Vi betalar ut cirka 260 miljarder kronor varje år. Det är allas skattepengar vi har hand om. Det är ett stort ansvar. Därför tänker vi nytt och använder den senaste tekniken för att förenkla och förbättra, utveckla och leverera it-tjänsterna för den svenska socialförsäkringen. Välkommen till en av Sveriges största IT-avdelningar.*

Leveransområdet Betalning hanterar de system på Försäkringskassan som säkerställer att utbetalningar når mottagaren i rätt tid. Vår insats är en förutsättning för att det svenska välfärdssystemet ska fungera. Det här är viktigt på riktigt. Vi behöver nu förstärkning till flera av våra team som jobbar med våra betalningssystem.


**Java, utveckling och agila team**
-----------------------------------


Vi jobbar i tätt samarbete mellan IT och verksamhet när vi skapar nya betalsystem och förvaltar våra befintliga. För att komma ännu längre på vår utvecklingsresa behöver vi stärka upp med fler drivna och nytänkande systemutvecklare som vill vara med att påverka och driva förändring.


Som systemutvecklare hos oss kommer du att jobba med både back-end och front-end utveckling. Vi arbetar i agila team, där teamen är självorganiserande och självgående. Du förväntas ta dig an olika uppgifter i hela utvecklingskedjan. Dev-Ops är numera en självklar del av teamets vardag.


Vi tror på att vi blir bättre när vi arbetar tillsammans och därför präglas vårt arbete av samarbete och dialog.


Tjänsten innebär att du hanterar sekretessbelagda uppgifter vilket ställer höga krav på rätt hantering. Därför är det viktigt att du som ska arbeta hos oss har högt säkerhetsmedvetande.


Det är ett jobb för dig som vill vara med och ta ansvar.


Vi söker dig som


* har högskoleexamen eller erfarenheter och kvalifikationer som kan prövas likvärdiga
* har relevant arbetslivserfarenhet i rollen som systemutvecklare
* har erfarenhet av programmering i Java
* agerar på eget initiativ och tar ansvar för resultat med hög kvalitet
* samarbetar effektivt för att nå gemensamma mål
* har god kommunikativ förmåga
* har goda kunskaper i svenska i tal och skrift.

Det är meriterande om du har


* erfarenhet av agila arbetssätt (exempelvis SAFe, Scrum eller Kanban)
* erfarenhet inom front-end utveckling inom exempelvis Vue eller React
* har erfarenhet av Openshift och Containerteknik
* har erfarenhet av arbete inom området Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (exempelvis Jenkins Pipeline, GitOps, Docker och Kubernetes)
* har erfarenhet av test och testautomatisering (Cucumber, Cypress)
* har erfarenhet av att arbeta med kravanalys.

Vi lägger stor vikt vid dina personliga egenskaper.


**Övrigt**
----------


Ett flertal tjänster, tillsvidare, heltid, med tillträde enligt överenskommelse. Provanställning kan bli aktuellt. Vissa anställningar hos oss innebär deltagande i säkerhetskänslig verksamhet. För att bli anställd i en sådan tjänst krävs godkänd säkerhetsprövning enligt säkerhetsskyddslagen (2018:585).


I enlighet med Försäkringskassans riktlinje för säkerhet genomförs bakgrundskontroller i denna rekrytering. Placeringsorter: Sundsvall eller Östersund.


Vill du veta mer om Försäkringskassan som arbetsgivare? Besök fk.se/jobbahososs


**Kontaktpersoner**
-------------------


Chef: Lars-Olof Svensson, 010-1187123; Jan Wallin 010-1134117; Stefan Bergsten 010-1187196; (för frågor om tjänsten). HR-specialist: Beatrice Sporre beatrice.sporre@forsakringskassan.se 010-114 47 79; Linnéa Palmkvist, linnea.palmkvist@forsakringskassan.se 010-113 10 46 (för frågor om rekryteringsprocessen). Fackliga representanter är för ST Anna-Lena Bahadori Lundgren, Saco-S Mohamed Abu-Torse, Seko Eliza Grundström. Dessa nås via vår växel 08-786 90 00.


**Ansökan**
-----------


Välkommen med din ansökan senast den 13 december 2026. När du ansöker bifogar du ditt CV. Vi använder inte personligt brev i våra rekryteringar, du får istället besvara ett antal urvalsfrågor som är relevanta för tjänsten. Ladda upp dina examensbevis, betyg och intyg i samband med din ansökan.


Har du skyddade personuppgifter eller ingen tillgång till bank-id ringer du den HR-specialist som finns namngiven i annonsen så får du hjälp med att skicka in din ansökan.


Vi ska i allt vi gör, agera med utgångspunkt i principen om alla människors lika värde, rättssäkerhet och med god service.

title: Javautvecklare
description:
Är du vass på utveckling och vill få möjligheten att förändra och förbättra samhället vi lever i? Du gillar att jobba i grupp och gillar att leda andra utvecklare. Nu söker vi en senior Java utvecklare till vårt team inom Financial Services i Stockholm.  

  

Som konsult och utvecklare på CGI kommer du erbjudas möjlighet att utvecklas som konsult både i lokala kundleveranser och i större globala åtaganden. Vårt arbetssätt bygger på närhet och långsiktiga kundrelationer. Vi vill vara våra kunders innovativa och proaktiva partner som hjälper dem att nå framgång i sin verksamhet. Vi erbjuder en spännande roll med nära samarbeten samt varierande och utvecklande arbetsuppgifter. Inom våra åtaganden strävar vi efter en miljö där vi stöttar varandra och har roligt på dagarna. Om du tycker att detta låter spännande så tveka inte att söka!

**Dina framtida arbetsuppgifter**


I rollen som senior Java utvecklare kommer dina ansvarsområden att vara:  

  

* Analys, systemdesign, utveckling och implementation av system och lösningar.
* Dokumentation i olika former.
* Dela kunskap med dina kollegor.
* Testarbete för att kvalitetssäkra leveranser till kund.
* Arbeta åt flera olika kunder och miljöer för att kontinuerligt utvecklas.
**Kvalifikationer för att bli framgångsrik denna roll**


Vi söker dig som har minst 5+ års erfarenhet av utveckling i Java och har erfarenhet av agil systemutvecklingsmetodik. För den här tjänsten behöver du även behärska svenska och engelska i både tal och skrift samt ha svenskt medborgarskap.  

  

Vi ser gärna att du har kompetens inom något av följande:  

* Java
* Kubernetes
* Grafana
* Kafka
* Apache Avro
* Postgre SQL
* Solution Design
* ISO20022

  

Du kommer att bli en viktig del i ett av våra team inom Financial Services. Vi ser att du är en teamspelare som både kan ge och ta i tekniska diskussioner såväl som förslag på lösningar. Vi ser också att det finns en vilja och nyfikenhet att lära sig nya saker, inte minst på teknisk nivå. Du är lyhörd och kan snabbt sätta dig in i kundens behov och hitta lämpliga lösningar.

title: Embedded Software Developer - DDU Real-Time Software
description:
TRATON is a group of strong brands with a shared mission: transforming transportation together to create the future of sustainable transport solutions. Within TRATON, we include MAN, Scania, Volkswagen Truck & Bus, and International. As part of a global team of industry experts, you get to think bigger, experience more, and reach further. Together, we have the power to transform transportation - Let´s make a difference together. Find out more: www.traton.com  

  



Our values – customer first, respect, team spirit, responsibility, and elimination of waste – are at the heart of everything we do.


**Role Summary**
----------------

  

  

*This role is a part of TRATON Group R&D, located in Södertälje, Sweden*  



Join a collaborative and highly skilled team at the heart of the TRATON Driver Interaction System. We build the real-time and embedded software that powers a safe, responsive, and reliable driver experience.

  

In this role, you’ll work on the foundation that ensures deterministic behavior, high performance, and seamless communication between hardware and higher-level applications. Your contributions will directly influence how drivers interact with next-generation vehicles.

  

**Job Responsibilities**
------------------------

  

As an Embedded Software Developer, you will play a key role in building safety-critical, real-time systems in a modern automotive environment. This is a hands-on role where you will take ownership, solve complex problems, and see your work come to life in real vehicles.

  

You will:

  

* Develop high-quality embedded software in C
* Drive and contribute to systemization and software architecture for real-time features within the DIM system
* Implement safety- and timing-critical functionality
* Design and execute tests across unit, SIL, and vehicle levels
* Debug complex issues and perform root cause analysis
* Support system integration and collaborate on feature development across the full DIM system
  
**Who You Are**
---------------

  

You are an engineer with a strong foundation in embedded systems and a passion for building robust, high-performance software. You enjoy working close to the hardware, solving real-world problems, and contributing to safety-critical systems. You have a collaborative, supportive mindset and a strong desire to learn.

  

We believe you bring some of the following:

  

* Experience in C and Python
* Knowledge of automotive communication protocols (e.g., CAN, CAN FD, Ethernet)
* Experience with testing methodologies (unit, integration, SIL, vehicle)
* Familiarity with TRATON in-house developed systems
* Experience working with functional safety according to ISO 26262
  

If you don’t meet every requirement but feel excited about the role, we still encourage you to apply - your perspective and experience could be exactly what we’re looking for.

  

*We welcome applicants from all backgrounds – your unique experience and perspectives is valuable to us.*

  

**This Is Us**
--------------

  

We’re experienced engineers and architects across the full development lifecycle - from early architecture to implementation, testing, and vehicle validation. Based in Sweden, our team operates in a global context, working closely with colleagues from diverse backgrounds and locations.

  

  

*Within TRATON Group R&D, you are an important part of something bigger. Joining us means gaining access to the ins and outs of the entire transportation industry.*  



**TRATON Offers**
-----------------

  

We offer a dynamic and engaging workplace where collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement are part of everyday life. You will be part of a strong team environment that encourages knowledge sharing and close cooperation across functions.

  

With a structured development plan and a wide range of training opportunities, TRATON Group R&D supports your professional growth both locally and internationally.

  

Benefits include access to our health center in Gröndal or a wellness allowance, bonus, flexible working hours, and company car leasing. We also arrange events for employees and their families, and for those living in Stockholm, convenient commuting is supported through direct Scania Job express buses to Södertälje.

  

**Application**
---------------

  

We look forward to receiving your application, consisting of your CV and kindly ask you not to share a cover letter to ensure an efficient and unbiased recruitment process for all parties.

  

  

Apply as soon as possible, no later than **2026-12-07**. Screening will take place on an ongoing basis during the application period. Logical and personality tests may be used as part of the selection process, and a background check may be required for this role.  



  

**If you have questions or would like more information, please contact:**
  

Jon Melin, Manager, jon.melin@se.traton.com  



  

**We look forward to your application!**

title: Mjukvaruutvecklare inom testautomation – Defense Tech
description:
Var med och bygg upp testautomation från grunden i ett snabbväxande Defense Tech-bolag! Här utvecklas avancerade tekniska system där mjukvara, elektronik och mekanik samverkar, och du får en central roll i att utveckla de automatiserade testsystem och testriggar som ska användas i produktionen. Med stort tekniskt ägandeskap, möjlighet att påverka och nära till innovativ teknik är det här en roll för dig som vill kombinera programmering med praktisk problemlösning och vara med på en spännande tillväxtresa. OM TJÄNSTEN: Friday söker för kunds räkning en mjukvaruutvecklare till ett innovativt start-up inom försvarsindustrin.
  
  

Bolaget befinner sig i en expansiv fas där produktionen byggs upp, vilket innebär att även testmiljöer, tekniska lösningar och arbetssätt behöver utvecklas från grunden. I rollen får du ett stort tekniskt ägandeskap för utvecklingen av automatiserade testsystem och testriggar som används för att verifiera avancerade produkter i produktionen. Du arbetar i gränslandet mellan mjukvara och elektronik och utvecklar bland annat programvara som kommunicerar med fysisk hårdvara, styr testutrustning, genomför mätningar och analyserar testresultat. Du kommer även att arbeta med hur mjukvara och firmware installeras, konfigureras och verifieras i produktionen.
  
  

Arbetet sker i nära samarbete med mjukvaru- och elektronikingenjörer, vilket ger dig möjlighet att förstå produkternas tekniska uppbyggnad och påverka hur de testas och kvalitetssäkras. Eftersom testautomationen byggs upp från grunden får du möjlighet att påverka tekniska vägval, testmetoder och hur lösningarna utformas. Här får du kombinera eget ansvar med praktiskt utvecklingsarbete och se dina lösningar bli en viktig del av en växande produktion. ARBETSUPPGIFTER: Utveckla automatiserade testsystem och testskript för elektronik och inbyggda system.
  
  

Utveckla testsekvenser, mätmetoder och automatiserad insamling av testresultat med fokus på kvalitet, spårbarhet och tillförlitlighet. Programmera mjukvara som kommunicerar med produkter, mätinstrument och annan testutrustning. Utveckla och bygga upp testriggar där mjukvara, elektronik och mekanik samverkar. Arbeta med installation, konfigurering och verifiering av mjukvara och firmware i produktionen.
  
  

Felsöka och analysera problem i gränssnittet mellan mjukvara och hårdvara. Utveckla testsekvenser, mätmetoder och automatiserad insamling av testresultat. Samarbeta med utvecklingsteam och produktion för att förbättra testbarhet, kvalitet och effektivitet. title: Software Developer
description:
Etraveli Group is a leading global flight technology provider, specializing in flight sales and offering flight content delivery and fintech products. We are here to solve complexity, by connecting millions of flights and travelers across the globe, from search and selection to trip and beyond. We partner with major global platforms such as Booking.com, Google Flights, Skyscanner, and Kayak, providing seamless flight booking and related services. Our B2B portfolio includes Precision, our specialist in travel fintech; Tripstack, our B2B Flights as a Service Provider and world leader in virtual interlining, serving as the gateway to Etraveli Group’s flight content and fulfillment services; Wenrix, the AI Infrastructure for profitable growth in air; and Flygresor.se, Sweden’s leading flight comparison site.
  
  

We also operate our own online travel agency brands including Gotogate, Mytrip, and Flightnetwork. Every day we strive to make the world smaller for our customers and bigger for our people. Our diverse team of more than 3200 passionate professionals is what makes us the industry’s tech wonder and the best in the world at what we do. Major offices in Sweden (HQ), Greece, India, Canada, Israel, Poland, UK, and Uruguay.
  
  

The Role Are you passionate about building the next generation of conversational AI experiences at global scale? At Etraveli Group, we are expanding our AI capabilities to reimagine how travelers search for and book flights. We are looking for a Software Developer to join our External API team and help drive our Model Context Protocol (MCP) initiative. In this role, you will build and scale the bridge that allows users to book flights seamlessly by interacting with an AI assistant connected directly to our core B2B APIs behind the scenes.
  
  

**What You Will Do Build & Scale MCP Integrations:** Design, develop, and maintain Model Context Protocol services that connect conversational AI interfaces with Etraveli Group’s internal B2B flight booking APIs. Ship Fast & Iterate: Jump straight into hands-on development—starting with bug fixes and targeted integration tasks—while helping shape the architecture of a rapidly evolving AI product space. Leverage AI-Assisted Workflows: Actively use modern AI development tools (such as Claude) as part of your daily engineering workflow for code generation, pull requests, and code reviews. Collaborate Across Functions: Work closely in a tight-knit two-person setup alongside a senior engineer dedicated to MCP, while collaborating with internal stakeholders across Corporate Development, Infrastructure Platforms, System Operations, and QA.
  
  

**Navigate a Fast-Moving Ecosystem:** Continuously adapt to rapid advancements in AI tooling and protocols while building deep domain knowledge of our internal flight-booking services.Security awareness. You’ve worked with OAuth 2.0 / PKCE, JWT validation, HMAC request signing, rate limiting and per-caller entitlements Your Team & Growth You will initially join the External API team, working closely with a dedicated senior engineer who will coach and onboard you into our systems. You will be part of a flat, collaborative engineering culture where great ideas matter more than job titles, and where you have direct visibility into how AI is transforming global travel tech. Requirements A strong technical background in building and running backend services, with several years of hands-on experience working in a modern language and framework.
  
  

Hands-on with LLM tooling, ideally the Model Context Protocol (MCP): tool and prompt design, JSON-RPC, structured output schemas, and writing tool descriptions and instructions that an AI assistant will actually follow. Experience integrating third-party APIs in production: you can read a partner’s contract, handle its quirks and failure modes, and keep the caller insulated from them. Security awareness. You’ve worked with OAuth 2.0 / PKCE, JWT validation, HMAC request signing, rate limiting and per-caller entitlements Strong pluses Flight or travel domain knowledge: fare brands, ATPCO ancillaries, seat maps, baggage, connections, self-transfer.
  
  

Kubernetes-based deployments, or comparable platform tooling. Benefits At the Etraveli Group Gothenburg office, you will be part of +200 people, all with different cutting-edge skills and personalities. Our shared ambition, passion, and strong work ethic are what drive us toward the same goals. This foundation allows us to value our individual differences, which we believe are precisely what make us a strong team.
  
  

**With us you can enjoy:** Our office is located in Merkurhuset in Gothenburg, a few steps away from public transport and lunch restaurants. We work on a hybrid-model where you can choose to work two days from home and you have two weeks per year that you can choose to work from a remote location We love gaming and after work activities. We know the value of personal development and continuous training. Hackathons and Dev Weeks - We believe in promoting creativity and trying new things.
  
  

Healthcare allowance – Each employee receives a maximum allowable amount each year according to the Swedish Tax Agency to spend on health-promoting activities such as a gym card, massage etc. Pension and health insurance – Through partners we offer a comprehensive pension and health insurance so that you can get help quickly in case of an accident. Daily breakfast – To kick the day off just right, breakfast is available at the office every morning. As part of this recruitment process, we will be conducting background checks.
  
  

You will be able to read more information and give your consent to this process in the application form.

title: Erfaren GIS-utvecklare ArcGIS & FME
description:
**Företagsbeskrivning**  

AFRY erbjuder tjänster inom teknik, design, digitalisering och rådgivning. Vi är dedikerade experter inom industri, energi och infrastruktur och skapar värde för kommande generationer. Var med och accelerera övergången till ett hållbart samhälle.

 **Jobbeskrivning**  

På AFRY Transmission Lines spelar GIS en central roll i alla projekt. Våra uppdrag sträcker sig från tidiga förstudie- och tillståndsprocesser till detaljprojektering och genomförande. Gemensamt för alla projekt är att de bidrar till utvecklingen av morgondagens energisystem och att geografisk information utgör en viktig del av beslutsunderlaget. Samtidigt genomgår branschen en omfattande digital transformation, där GIS och geodata får en allt viktigare roll. Därför handlar den här tjänsten inte bara om GIS-samordning, utan också om att utveckla smarta och effektiva arbetssätt med digitala lösningar som skapar värde


Just nu söker vi fler härliga kollegor som vill jobba med oss. Vi söker en erfaren GIS-utvecklare med kompetens inom GIS, FME och automatiserad geodatabearbetning. Vi söker dig som har gedigen erfarenhet av GIS och FME samt en god förmåga att utveckla tekniska lösningar för hantering, bearbetning och integration av geodata. I rollen arbetar du med automatisering, systemintegration och utveckling av effektiva arbetssätt. Du bygger lösningar där geodata hämtas från olika källor, bearbetas och kvalitetssäkras för att sedan levereras eller publiceras vidare till andra system.


Du är kommunikativ och har förmågan att omsätta verksamhetsbehov till användbara och effektiva geospatiala lösningar. Med lätthet anpassar du din kommunikation till olika målgrupper och kan diskutera tekniska frågor både med specialister och personer utan djup teknisk bakgrund. Samtidigt ser du värdet i struktur, etablerade arbetssätt och långsiktig förvaltning. Du har förmågan att kombinera utveckling av nya lösningar med förvaltning och arbete inom etablerade processer och tekniska ramverk.


Placeringsort är flexibel vid rätt kompetens, men det underlättar om du har närhet till något av våra kontor i Stockholm, Uppsala, Göteborg, Karlstad, Trollhättan eller Malmö.


Som GIS-utvecklare får du:

* Designa, utveckla och förvalta automatiserade geospatiala arbetsflöden, framför allt med FME
* Bearbeta, transformera, kvalitetssäkra och integrera geodata från olika system och datakällor
* Arbeta med FME Form, FME Flow, GIS-plattformar och geodatabaser
* Utveckla lösningar för hantering och analys av både vektordata, rasterdata och LiDAR-punktmoln.
* Omsätta verksamhets- och projektbehov till konkreta tekniska lösningar
* Bidra med teknisk rådgivning, metodutveckling och kunskapsdelning inom geospatial teknik

**Vad får du**


Du blir en del av ett engagerat GIS- team med 12 kollegor och får dessutom tillgång till AFRY:s Geospatiala globala nätverk av specialister. Inom Transmission Lines samarbetar du även med cirka 90 kollegor med kompetens inom tillståndsfrågor, projektering och konstruktion. Tillsammans arbetar vi över kompetensgränserna för att hitta de bästa lösningarna och bidra till några av de mest samhällsviktiga projekten inom energiomställningen. Hos oss får du möjlighet att använda din erfarenhet i några av Nordens mest samhällsviktiga elnätsprojekt. Du blir en del av ett engagerat och prestigelöst team med kompetenta och härliga kollegor där det finns utrymme att växa och ta ansvar oavsett om du redan är varm i kläderna eller vill ta nästa steg i din utveckling.

 **Kvalifikationer**  

Personliga kompetenser är något vi värderar högt för att du ska trivas och lyckas i rollen. Du har ett genuint intresse för vårt teknikområde och en vilja att fortsätta utvecklas inom det du gör. Du tar dig an komplexa frågor på ett analytiskt och lösningsfokuserat sätt och hittar vägar framåt även när uppgifterna är utmanande.


Som person är du prestigelös och lyhörd. Du tar gärna del av andras expertis, delar med dig av din egen och är öppen för olika perspektiv. Du bidrar till ett arbetsklimat där frågor och idéer tas emot på ett positivt sätt. Du är ansvarstagande och ser hög kvalitet som en självklarhet. När det behövs hjälper du kollegor och ser värdet i att lösa saker tillsammans så att vi som team når våra gemensamma mål.

**Skakrav:**

* Relevant eftergymnasial utbildning

* Minst 3 års erfarenhet av arbete inom Esri-plattformen

* Erfarenhet av programmering i Python eller annat relevant programmeringsspråk
* Erfarenhet av att utveckla eller förvalta integrationer mellan system, API:er och datakällor

**Meriterande:**

Eftersom tjänsten kan komma att verka inom säkerhetsklassade områden kan det bli aktuellt med drogtester och säkerhetsprövningar innan anställning kan påbörjas. För samtliga rekryteringar på AFRY genomförs ID-kontroll, referenstagning samt verifiering av utbildning inför en anställning.

Elizaveta Chashchyna, Elizaveta.Chashchyna@afry.com


Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

title: Senior Backend Developer
description:
Do you enjoy solving complex technical challenges and shaping the architecture of games played by millions?


As a Principal Server Engineer at Snowprint, you are part of a game team, designing, developing and operating the game. You'll combine hands-on development with long-term technical vision. Everything you do impacts the player experience and how we build games.


At Snowprint Studios, we believe that kindness, collaboration, curiosity, and taking ownership are what make great games possible. We work in small, cross-disciplinary teams where people are trusted to take responsibility, share ideas openly, and continuously improve how we build games together.

### **What you’ll be doing**


Together with the team, you'll shape the architecture and technical direction of our backend systems, designing and implementing solutions that support both current game features and future needs. You'll take the lead on complex technical features.


You'll work on both player-facing features and the systems, tooling and infrastructure behind them. This includes evolving our existing architecture, identifying opportunities for improvement, and ensuring our backend solutions remain scalable, maintainable, efficient and secure as our games grow.


You'll also play an important role in the technical development of the team. Working closely with other developers, you'll share knowledge, challenge ideas, provide technical guidance and help establish good practices. You'll collaborate with designers and other disciplines to ensure that technical decisions support both development needs and the player experience.

### **Is this you?**

* **You're a highly experienced server/backend engineer** with a strong background in designing, building, and operating complex backend systems. You're fluent in **Kotlin and/or Java**.
* **You have experience shaping backend architecture and making technical decisions** that balance immediate requirements with long-term scalability and maintainability.
* **You're comfortable taking ownership of cloud infrastructure** and have hands-on experience operating cloud environments.
* **You have extensive experience with live services** and understand the demands of keeping a game running. You're comfortable troubleshooting production issues, adapting to changing priorities, and finding solutions when things don't go as planned.
* **You're a strong technical voice who enjoys sharing knowledge, challenging ideas, and helping others grow**. You communicate clearly, collaborate well and can explain complex technical decisions to people from different disciplines.

### **Where you’ll work**


Our Stockholm studio is located in Södermalm, and we work in a hybrid setup. We work from the office on Tuesdays and Fridays to support collaboration and social interaction, while other days offer flexibility depending on where you work best. We provide the setup and tools you need to work comfortably both at home and in the studio.

### **About Snowprint Studios**


Snowprint Studios believes great games are created by teams of talented, kind and creative individuals in a friendly, supportive and inspiring environment - while maintaining a sustainable life-work balance. For more information on Snowprint Studios go to snowprintstudios.com and follow us on Facebook.


At Snowprint Studios, we embrace diversity both in the worlds we create and in our workplace. Join us in shaping the future of gaming!

* Pocket Gamer Awards Winner ‘Mobile game of the year’ and ‘Best strategy game’ 2022
* Pocket Gamer Awards Winner 'Best game we are still playing’ 2024 & 2026
* Pocket Gamer Awards Finalist, ‘Best developer’ 2025
* Pocket Gamer Awards Winner, ‘Best updated game’ & ‘Best community’ 2026

##### **Good to know**


We are an international company with many nationalities represented. Our company language is English, so your application should therefore be in English.

**Digital transformation av systemutveckling**

title: Junior Software Developer
description:
**Join our Team**
-----------------


**About this opportunity:**

  

At Ericsson, we are shaping the future of connectivity. Through our NextGen Program, we are looking for curious, ambitious, and innovative engineers who want to begin their careers by working on technologies that connect billions of people worldwide.


As a Software Developer in our organization, you will be part of a global team developing the software platforms and capabilities that power Ericsson's Purpose-built and Cloud RAN solutions. You will work with experienced engineers in a collaborative environment where learning, innovation, and teamwork are at the core of everything we do.


This is an opportunity to contribute to cutting-edge technology while building a strong foundation for your future career. You will gain hands-on experience with modern software engineering practices, cloud-native technologies, automation, AI-assisted development, and large-scale distributed systems.

 **About our organisation**

  

Product Engineering Group 3 (PEG 3) is part of Product Engineering Unit RAN Performance (PEU RP), which develops Ericsson's Baseband software for the Purpose-built and Cloud RAN portfolio. We create software solutions that enable high-performance, scalable, secure, and energy-efficient mobile networks used by communication service providers around the world.


As the industry continues its transformation toward cloud-native architectures, our teams are driving the evolution of Cloud RAN solutions and preparing the foundations for future networks. In addition to advancing today's 5G capabilities, we are actively developing technologies that will contribute to 6G, the next generation of mobile communications.


By joining us, you will have the opportunity to work on technologies that will shape the future of connectivity for years to come.

 **What you will do:**

  

* Develop and maintain software for Ericsson's Baseband and Cloud RAN solutions
* Design, implement, test, and troubleshoot software components
* Contribute to software architectural improvement
* Work with automation, continuous integration, and continuous delivery practices
* Leverage AI and automation to increase productivity and reduce lead time
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams across Ericsson's global R&D organization
* Learn and apply modern software engineering methodologies and AI-enabled development tools
* Contribute to innovations supporting the evolution from 5G Advanced toward future 6G networks

 **The skills you bring:**

  

We recruit for potential and believe that curiosity, learning ability, and collaboration are key ingredients for success.


You may be a recent graduate or have a few years of professional experience and possess:

* MSc or BSc in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Telecommunications, or another relevant field

* Interest in software development, AI, machine learning, and telecommunications
* Familiarity with AI-assisted software development and coding assistants (Coding Buddy, GitHub Copilot, or similar tools) is an advantage

* A growth mindset and willingness to continuously learn
* Ability to collaborate effectively in diverse and international teams

You´ll be joining a team of diverse innovators, all driven to go beyond the status quo to craft what comes next.

We truly believe that by collaborating with people with different experiences we drive innovation, which is essential for our future growth. We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply and realize their full potential as part of our Ericsson team. Ericsson is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. learn more.

title: AI Security Developer
description:
**Join our Team**
-----------------


**About this opportunity:**


If you want to help shape the future of Ericsson by bringing AI into product security verification teams, this could be the role for you.


Ericsson’s products need to be secure, reliable and ready for the demands of the networks of tomorrow. As a junior developer in the Product Security sector, you will help to drive the integration of AI capabilities into the Vulnerability Analysis (VA) workflow, automating repetitive tasks, improving detection accuracy, and accelerating triage and reporting while maintaining the security posture of the products.


You’ll collaborate with experienced colleagues across Product Security and verification, learning how complex telecom products are developed and assessed. This is an opportunity to build your skills at the intersection of AI, software engineering and cybersecurity, while contributing to Ericsson’s work on current and future RAN technologies.

**What you will do:**


As a member of our team, you will strengthen our AI capabilities and support teams in developing AI agents and workflows. You will:

* Identify opportunities to use AI/ML to streamline engineering processes and workflows.
* Prototype and develop AI agents and workflow automations for practical tasks across the engineering lifecycle, from analysis through verification.
* Introduce AI-enabled solutions to verification teams, document AI tools, workflows, and best practices for team adoption.
* Maintain and improve AI/ML tools and solutions together with experienced colleagues
* Support the integration of AI solutions into existing CI/CD pipelines and VA toolchains
* Help build and maintain data pipelines to collect, clean, and prepare VA data
* Contribute to developing and integrating LLM-based tooling (e.g., AI agents, RAG systems) to assist with VA analysis, report writing, and knowledge retrieval
* Explore how AI agents can work with tools, APIs, and existing development or verification workflows.
* Stay current on AI/ML trends relevant to cybersecurity and vulnerability analysis and contribute to knowledge-sharing sessions
* Analyze and communicate results, insights, and recommendations to other colleagues
* Consider security, privacy, and responsible AI practices when exploring and applying AI/ML.

 **The skills you bring:**

* Master’s degree in Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning, Data Science, Computer Science, or a related field.
* Solid foundation in machine learning and data analytics, with an interest in applying AI/ML to practical engineering challenges.
* Programming skills primary in Python.
* Experience with LLM, prompt engineering, API development and AI agents.
* Familiarity with AI platforms and frameworks such as AWS/Kiro, OpenAI, RAG, MCP, or similar is an advantage.
* Good practices in software development.
* Familiarity with Linux/Unix environments and version control tools such as Git.
* An interest in software development workflows, including CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and continuous integration and delivery. Experience building or improving these workflows is a plus.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a willingness to experiment, evaluate results.
* Motivation to learn testing, verification, and how to validate automated results.
* A self-driven, proactive, and collaborative approach, with clear communication skills and good written and spoken English.
* An interest in cybersecurity, prior security knowledge or experience is an advantage, but not a requirement.

### **About the role**


You will join cross-functional product teams and use user-centred, evidence-based design to improve customer journeys. The role combines independent ownership of design deliverables with close collaboration across business and technology teams.

We are looking for a Senior Product Designer for a cross-platform digital product assignment in Stockholm. You will shape intuitive, polished experiences across screens, devices and contexts, from desktop and TV to automotive and wearables.


This is an opportunity to combine end-to-end product design with close collaboration across product, engineering, research and external technology partners, making a meaningful impact from the start.

### **About the role**


You will design cohesive and platform-appropriate experiences across digital touchpoints, adapting interactions to different screen sizes, input methods and usage contexts. You will balance consistency with native platform conventions and help translate ambiguous requirements into clear design solutions.

### **Key responsibilities**

* Design end-to-end user experiences for TV, desktop, automotive, wearables, mobile web and connected-device scenarios.
* Develop user flows, interaction designs, visual concepts and high-fidelity prototypes adapted to platform-specific constraints.
* Work closely with product, engineering, research and partner teams to shape scope and deliver high-quality solutions.
* Present design rationale, communicate trade-offs and influence external partner discussions.
* Use and evolve design-system components to support consistent experiences across platforms.
* Navigate new problem spaces independently and deliver impactful work quickly.

### **What we're looking for**


To succeed in this role, you bring:

* Strong senior-level product design experience delivering digital products, ideally across multiple platforms or device types.
* A portfolio demonstrating interaction design, visual craft, prototyping and sound design reasoning.
* Experience designing for different device constraints and contexts, or a proven ability to adapt rapidly beyond mobile.
* Excellent communication skills and confidence presenting and discussing design with stakeholders and external partners.
* Systems thinking and the ability to understand how decisions affect connected experiences and ecosystems.
* A self-directed approach, with the ability to build context and work effectively amid ambiguity.
* Fluency in Figma and modern prototyping tools, including experience using AI tools in the design workflow.
* Full professional proficiency in English.

### **Nice to have**

* Experience designing within partner platforms or ecosystems where you do not control the entire user experience.
* Familiarity with tvOS, Android TV/Google TV, CarPlay/Android Auto, Wear OS or watchOS guidelines.
* Experience with multi-device, social or AI-powered experiences.

### **About you**


You are curious, versatile and confident in your craft. You can move from broad experience strategy to pixel-level details, build trust across disciplines and communicate clear decisions even when requirements are evolving.

### **Assignment details**

* **Location:** Stockholm, Sweden
* **Working model:** Hybrid
* **Duration:** Approximately 4–6 months
* **Start:** As soon as possible
* **Seniority:** Senior
* **Language:** English, full professional proficiency

title: Senior UX Designer – Digital Customer Experience, Stockholm
description:
We are looking for an experienced Senior UX Designer to create meaningful digital customer experiences for a Nordic retail and e-commerce environment. In this full-time consulting assignment, you will take responsive web solutions from early concepts through development, working closely with designers, developers and business stakeholders. About the role You will join cross-functional product teams and use user-centred, evidence-based design to improve customer journeys. The role combines independent ownership of design deliverables with close collaboration across business and technology teams.
  
  

Your responsibilities Design responsive web experiences that address customer needs and business goals. Apply Design Thinking methods to explore opportunities and shape digital products with multidisciplinary teams. Gather stakeholder and customer insights, formulate and test hypotheses, and translate feedback into clear design requirements. Create and document user flows, detailed sitemaps, wireframes and interactive prototypes.
  
  

Iterate designs based on research, data and stakeholder feedback. Deliver polished, accessible and consistent UX/UI solutions using established design systems. Present design decisions clearly and collaborate with developers through implementation. Plan and manage your own design work to deliver high-quality results.
  
  

Requirements At least 5 years of professional experience in digital product design. A bachelor's or master's degree in Art, Design, Human-Computer Interaction (HCI) or a related field. Proven experience delivering digital products in multidisciplinary teams. Strong UX and UI design expertise, with knowledge of current digital design methods and approaches to complex problems.
  
  

Experience creating and documenting user flows, detailed sitemaps and wireframes. Proficiency with design and prototyping tools, including rapid iteration of concepts and prototypes. Ability to derive customer insights from data-driven environments and apply them to design decisions. Experience facilitating meetings and workshops.
  
  

Experience applying design systems in digital products. Excellent communication skills, including presenting design decisions and translating stakeholder feedback into actionable requirements. Strong attention to detail, independent working style and ability to organise design tasks effectively. Full professional proficiency in English.
  
  

⭐ Nice to have Experience using AI tools in everyday design work, with an interest in improving quality and efficiency through AI. About you You combine thoughtful user experience design with strong delivery skills. You are comfortable collaborating with stakeholders across functions, translating feedback into practical solutions and maintaining a high standard of quality and accessibility. title: Manager Enablement ﻿
description:
*Passionate about making ideas a reality? Join our welcoming world of tech and let your ideas soar.*

  

**Your role**


We are looking for a passionate and driven First-Line Manager to lead our Enablement section within GBAD C2. This is a key leadership role in an organisation focused on delivering advanced command and control capabilities.

  

  

The Enablement section plays a critical role in supporting the entire department. The team brings together expertise within AI, UX, Configuration Management (CM), CI/CD, and Test Automation, and acts as a force multiplier—ensuring that teams across the department have the tools, methods, and capabilities required to successfully deliver products and projects.  

  



As a manager, you will lead a diverse and highly skilled group of specialists and ensure that their competencies are effectively aligned with the needs of the organisation.

  

  

Your responsibilities:


* Lead, coach, and develop a cross-functional team of experts within AI, UX, CM, CI/CD, and test automation
* Enable the department to succeed by ensuring strong collaboration, support structures, and capability development
* Act as a bridge between technical domains, fostering integration across disciplines
* Drive continuous improvement in ways of working, tools, and processes
* Build a culture of trust, transparency, and engagement
* Contribute to strategic planning and operational execution within GBAD C2
  

  

  

**Your profile**


We are looking for a leader who combines technical understanding with strong people leadership skills.

  

  

You have:


* Good understanding of both User Experience (UX) and modern CI/CD practices and tools
* Experience working at the intersection of several of the following areas: AI, UX, software engineering, CI/CD, test automation, or configuration management
* A solid understanding of modern development environments and enabling functions
* Previous leadership experience, or a strong readiness to take on a formal leadership role
  

  

Leadership profile


You lead with both head and heart. You are:


* People-centric – you genuinely care about your team members’ growth, well-being, and success
* Communicative – you create clarity, actively listen, and foster open dialogue
* Driven – you take initiative and create momentum
* Transparent – you build trust through openness and honesty
* Collaborative – you naturally connect people and competencies across organisational boundaries
  

  

Merits:


Experience from defense or other safety-critical industries, systems engineering, international work  

* 

*This position requires that you pass a security vetting based on the current regulations around/of security protection. For positions requiring* *security clearance additional obligations on citizenship may apply.*

  

  

  

**Why join us?**


We offer an exciting and dynamic work environment where you will work with cutting-edge technology and contribute to solutions that truly make a difference. As a leader with us, you will have the opportunity to influence and grow within an organization that values innovation, collaboration, and personal development.

  

  

  

**What you will be part of**


Explore a wealth of possibilities. Take on challenges, create smart inventions, and grow beyond. This is a place for curious minds, brave pioneers, and everyone in between. Together, we achieve the extraordinary, each bringing our unique perspectives. Your part matters.

  

  

Saab is a leading defense and security company with an enduring purpose, to help nations keep their people and society safe. Empowered by its 28,000 talented people, Saab constantly pushes the boundaries of technology to create a safer and more sustainable world.

  

  

Saab designs, manufactures and maintains advanced systems in aeronautics, weapons, command and control, sensors and underwater systems. Saab is headquartered in Sweden. It has major operations all over the world and is part of the domestic defense capability of several nations. Read more about us here

title: Senior Software Engineer - Frontend (Portfolio Brands)
description:
**Job Description** **WHAT YOU’LL DO**


We are seeking a skilled and experienced **Software Engineer** with expertise in **React, Typescript,** and **Next.JS** to join our dynamic development team. As an experienced Frontend Engineer, you will be responsible for designing and implementing the user interface of our web applications using React and related technologies. You will work in an agile team and collaborate with our product managers, designers, and backend engineers to deliver high-quality, scalable, and user-friendly software solutions.  

  

**Some of your responsibilities will include:**

* Design, develop, and maintain responsive, accessible, and high-performance web applications for COS application in Portfolio Brands
* Strong working experience in Next.js, React, Typescript, Tailwind CSS, Github actions
* Experience in system design, headless CMS, component-driven architectures, e-commerce, SaaS, or large-scale enterprise applications
* Based in Stockholm and come to H&M Office in Stockholm atleast 4 days in a week
* Collaborate with product owners, UX/UI designers, architects, and backend engineers to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
* Drive technical excellence through code reviews, design reviews, and implementation of engineering standards.
* AI First development mindset
* Strong problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience working in Agile development environments.
* Strong understanding of frontend architecture patterns and state management solutions.
* Strong integrating RESTful APIs and GraphQL working with backend services.
* Proficiency with version control systems such as Git.
* Experience with testing frameworks and automated testing strategies.
* Experience with cloud platforms Azure, or Aws or Google Cloud.
* Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.

**WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH**


The Portfolio Brands domain enables brand-unique customer experiences and partnership solutions for our four Portfolio Brands. The domain has three areas, PB Digital Experience delivering the e-commerce platform and associated customer facing experience, PB Store Experience enabling our brands to create lasting store experiences for each brand and PB Partnership Solutions supporting PBs growth agenda through external sales.  

  

Digital Experience delivers the e-commerce platform and the ecosystem of composable solutions for our Portfolio Brands, ensuring unique brand experiences can be implemented. The area leads business development and expertise across the e-commerce platform, digital marketing and omni-channel experience, ensuring stable operations as well as strategic vendor management.  

  

COS offers a wardrobe of ready-to-wear, and accessories rooted in exceptional quality and lasting design. The creative soul of the brand is fuelled by a deep connection to modern culture, dynamic global cities and compelling fashion movements. With an emphasis on expert craftsmanship, innovation and materiality, collections are created with a mindful approach, seamlessly blending contemporary and timeless.

 **Qualifications** **WHO YOU ARE**


We are looking for people with…

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience), and **6+ years** of experience as a Software Engineer.
* Proven work experience as a Frontend Engineer, preferably with a focus on **Next.JS**
* Strong proficiency in **JavaScript, Typescript,** HTML, and CSS.
* Experience in **system design, headless CMS, component-driven architectures, e-commerce**, SaaS, or large-scale enterprise applications
* Experience with React.js and its core principles.
* Experience with Node.js is preferable.
* Strong communication skills to collaborate with our clients and gather requirements.
* Familiarity with popular React libraries and frameworks such as Redux, React Router, or Next.js.
* Understanding of responsive design principles and mobile-first development.
* Knowledge of frontend build tools and module bundlers such as Webpack or Babel.
* Experience with version control systems, preferably Git.
* Ability to collaborate effectively in a team environment and communicate technical concepts.
* Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to quickly learn and adapt to new technologies and frameworks.
* Experience with backend technologies and RESTful APIs.
* Familiarity with testing frameworks such as Jest or React Testing Library.
* Knowledge of UI/UX design principles and ability to work closely with designers.
* Familiarity with Agile/Scrum development methodologies

  

**Additional Information** **WHO WE ARE**


H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.


We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future.

**WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE**


At H&M Group, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe.

* Staff discount card, usable on all our H&M Group brands in stores and online.
* Included in our H&M Incentive Program – HIP. You can read more about our H&M Incentive Program here.
* Collective Agreement and ITP pensions competitive to Swedish market.
* 30 days vacation, health care allowance and good work-life balance.
* Additional perks and discounts from Benify.

**JOIN US**  

Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are.


This is a fulltime permanent position, starting as soon as possible according to agreement. The role is a hybrid position, based in our office in Stockholm, Sweden.

**Apply as soon as possible by sending in your CV in English.** Due to data policies, we only accept applications through career page.


Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here. We are eager to meet you!

title: Software Engineer
description:
Software Engineer – Join Us in Building the Future of Dairy Farming at DeLaval Are you a software developer who enjoys solving real-world problems with clean, scalable code? Do you want your work to have a meaningful impact beyond the screen? At DeLaval, we’re looking for a technically driven and collaborative Software Developer to join our cross-functional team developing DeLaval Plus – our digital platform supporting modern dairy farmers around the world. Role and responsibilities In this role, you’ll work closely with Product Owners, Project Managers, Scrum Masters, UX Designers, QA Engineers, and other developers to build and maintain the frontend and backend services powering the DeLaval Plus website.
  
  

You’ll be involved in the entire feature lifecycle – from design and development to testing, deployment, monitoring, and incident handling. You will build and evolve functionality that supports our users in their daily work. You’ll help shape robust, secure, scalable, and observable services using modern, cloud-native technologies. This role is ideal for someone who’s excited to deliver reliable systems at scale, enjoys working with data-intensive applications, and is passionate about making a difference in the lives of real users.
  
  

What You’ll Be Doing Design, build, and maintain services for DeLaval Plus Collaborate with a cross-functional team to deliver high-quality features end to end Write secure and testable APIs following OWASP and clean code principles Manage infrastructure and deployments using modern IaC and DevOps tools Work on data-heavy services that are central to our platform’s performance and reliability Monitor services in production, respond to incidents, and continuously improve system resilience Contribute to our culture of learning and knowledge sharing Qualifications We’re looking for someone with at least 7 years of software development experience. You should also have a solid foundation in computer science, with strong knowledge of frontend and backend development. You also have hands-on experience with most or all of the following: Languages & Runtime: JavaScript, TypeScript, Node.js, npm Cloud & Infrastructure: AWS (Lambda, S3, DynamoDB, RDS, VPC), CDK, Kubernetes, Terraform Architecture & Patterns: REST API development, API security (authentication, authorization, OWASP best practices), event-driven architecture Testing & Quality: Jest (unit testing), Cypress (E2E), JMeter (load testing), SonarQube DevOps & Observability: Git, CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Grafana, Loki, Sentry, OpsGenie Best Practices: Clean code, secure coding, code reviews, production monitoring, incident response Special Focus: Experience working with data-intensive and high-traffic applications Computer Science Fundamentals: Algorithms, data structures, system design Who You Are You’re not just a developer – you’re a team player and a problem solver. We believe you’ll thrive here if you: Take responsibility for your work and follow through Have strong technical curiosity and a drive to continuously learn Are proactive and enjoy taking initiative Value collaboration and helping others succeed Have experience handling incidents and working with customer service to improve production systems Have worked with production-grade systems and understand the importance of qu ality, reliability, and supportability Are fluent in English (required) and preferably also in Swedish Are able and willing to work from our Tumba office at least 3 days per week Additional information This is a full-time position based at DeLaval’s headquarters in Tumba, south of Stockholm.
  
  

We offer a hybrid workplace model, combining on-site work with flexibility to work remotely. Apply today and help us shape the future of farming. Contact Hiring manager: Sara Neander Bjorklund, sara.neanderbjorklundext@delaval.com Recruiter: Mathias Gunnstedt, mathias.gunnstedt@delaval.com About DeLaval Our vision is to make sustainable food production possible. As a company built on innovation, we constantly work to find ways of helping our customers, dairy farmers, do more with less by providing world-leading milking equipment and solutions.
  
  

Today, DeLaval has approximately 4,900 passionate professionals operating in more than 90 markets around the world. DeLaval is part of the Tetra Laval Group. See more at corporate.delaval.com

title: Fullstack Engineer (Mid Level)
description:
###### **About Perceptic**


The highest calling for technology is improving human health.


At Perceptic, we're building the operating system for drug discovery: a unified intelligence layer that connects evidence, reasoning and action across the entire drug lifecycle.


Our founding team comes from Palantir, where they spent years shipping production software and built AIP for Life Sciences in some of the most demanding enterprise environments in the world. We know what it takes to make ambitious technology hold up under real pressure. Now we're bringing that to pharma, and we're looking for engineers who want to work to the same standard.

**The role**


We're hiring a Full-Stack Product Engineer who has already shipped real product and is ready to own more of it. You've built features across the stack, seen them used (and broken) by real people, and done the work to make them reliable. Now you want bigger problems, more ownership and a faster path to growth.


The core challenge is turning the world's scientific evidence into a product a pharma scientist will trust with a major decision. That demands carefully built software at every layer: data models that hold up against messy reality, APIs that stay coherent as the product grows, and interfaces that make complex reasoning easy to follow and verify.

**Our stack**


React and TypeScript on the front end, and Python services behind it, and an agent layer built on durable, fault-tolerant workflows that reason over scientific data through a growing set of tools and integrations. We keep our technology choices few and high-leverage, and you'll work across all of them.

**What you'll work on**

* Building product features end to end across frontend, backend, data and API layers, and seeing them through to production
* Shaping how AI-powered scientific workflows (agents, retrieval and tool use) reach users in a way that earns their confidence
* Designing APIs and data models that keep a fast-moving product clean and coherent
* Frontend architecture and performance, including component design, state management and rendering, so a dense tool still feels light
* Trust features such as provenance, citations and confidence indicators that let scientists check the work behind every answer
* Testing, observability and release processes that let us ship daily without breaking things for customers
* Working directly with founders, customers and domain experts to turn ambiguous problems into shipped product
* Using automation, AI-assisted development and internal tooling to help a small team move like a much larger one


What we're looking for

* 2–4 years of professional engineering experience, with real full-stack range. You may be stronger on one side, but you're capable and productive on both.
* You've shipped features that people use, and you can walk us through them
* You can talk concretely about schema design, API contracts, caching, latency, failure modes and the UX tradeoffs you've made
* You're comfortable building on top of AI systems and use AI coding tools fluently, with clear views on where they help and where they don't
* You've worked somewhere with a high engineering bar, whether that's a top tech company, an AI lab, or a strong product team at a fast-growing startup
* You have good product instincts and can make pragmatic decisions without waiting for perfect requirements
* You want more ownership, pace and upside than your current environment offers

 **What to expect and what we offer**


This is a high-intensity, high-stakes role. We move quickly and give direct feedback. Your responsibility will likely outgrow your title, and you'll go wherever the company needs you most, which sometimes means unglamorous work that matters more than anything else that week.


The people who thrive here find that kind of ownership and growth exciting, and they aren't looking for a nine-to-five.  

  

**Office Location:** Central London (Soho) - 3 days in office  

**Package:** £75,000 -£110,000 + shares + private medical
