I Skellefteå har vi ett härligt och växande team på 21 personer med stark gemenskap och hög närvaro på kontoret. Här gillar vi att ses, samarbeta och ha roligt tillsammans, samtidigt som vi arbetar nära våra kunder med spännande uppdrag inom IT och tech. AI är en naturlig del av hur vi arbetar, utvecklar lösningar och skapar värde för våra kunder, lokalt, nationellt och globalt.

  

  

Som Teamchef får du en viktig roll i att utveckla människorna och affären i Skellefteå, samtidigt som du blir en del av den regionala ledningsgruppen. Du har personalansvar för 16 medarbetare och skapar genom ett närvarande och coachande ledarskap förutsättningar för människor att utvecklas, ta ansvar och lyckas.Rollen kombinerar ledarskap med ett nära engagemang i vår affär. **Din profil**

* Du tycker om att bygga relationer och förstå vad kunder faktiskt behöver. Att hitta nya möjligheter, utveckla affärer och skapa konkret kundvärde är något som motiverar dig.
* Du är nyfiken på hur AI och ny teknologi förändrar våra kunders verksamheter och konsultrollen och vill bidra till utvecklingen.
* Du tar gärna initiativ och får saker att hända, men tror samtidigt på kraften i att göra saker tillsammans. Du skapar förtroende, ger andra utrymme att växa och bidrar med energi och riktning när det behövs.
* Du kommunicerar obehindrat på svenska och engelska och trivs med ett närvarande ledarskap, där du regelbundet är på plats och kontoret i Skellefteå är en naturlig utgångspunkt.
  

  

**Vad vi tror kommer få dig att trivas**


* Du kliver in i ett härligt team på 21 personer som växer, där många arbetar från kontoret och det finns en genuin vilja att samarbeta och ha roligt tillsammans.
* Som Teamchef får du stort utrymme att tillsammans med teamet forma vår verksamhet, våra kompetenser och affär i Skellefteå.
* Du leder människor samtidigt som du själv fortsätter vara nära kunderna och affären genom konsultuppdrag eller försäljning.
* Du blir en del av en verksamhet där AI och ny teknologi är en naturlig del av hur vi utvecklar våra arbetssätt och skapar kundvärde.
* Du får det bästa av två världar: ett nära team och kundrelationer i Skellefteå, med samarbeten och möjligheter nationellt och globalt.
  

  

**Ansökan**

*Låter det som en roll för dig? Varmt välkommen med din ansökan. Vi ser fram emot att lära känna dig och höra mer om vad du vill bidra med till vårt team i Skellefteå.* *Som en del av vår rekryteringsprocess kommer identitetskontroll att genomföras genom granskning av ditt ID-kort, och bakgrundskontroller kan utföras vid behov.*


**Om Sogeti**
  

Sogeti Sverige, en del av Capgemini Group, med 19 kontor och 1200 medarbetare, gör teknologi enkelt och värdeskapande. Vi är specialiserade på AI-drivna lösningar inom quality engineering & testing, data och cloud och förvandlar snabbt idéer till handling. Sogeti levererar konkreta resultat, hjälper organisationer att innovera med självförtroende och skapar värde från dag ett. Vi är agila, snabbrörliga och drar nytta av starka partnerskap. Våra lokala team arbetar sida vid sida med våra kunder och bygger nära relationer genom att förstå deras verklighet. Tillsammans med Capgemini-koncernens globala styrka och branschexpertis skapar vi skalbara resultat.

title: Consultant / Senior Consultant, Financial Services Transformation
description:
**Make an impact in financial services transformation**

Are you ready to take the next step in your career and join our successful teams in Sweden? Deloitte is a market leader in Sweden, working with decision-makers across global and local organisations. As a Consultant or Senior Consultant in the Operations Transformation or Engineering team, you will help leading financial institutions translate complex business and technology challenges into practical transformation initiatives.


You will help financial services clients innovate and transform their organisations, core systems and operating models. This includes driving business transformation, consolidating and implementing systems and processes, embedding regulatory change and operational efficiency, designing new operating models, and leading large-scale transformations.


**Requirements to succeed in this role**

We will assess your level based on the depth of your experience and the scope of responsibility you have held. You are expected to have 1-4 years of professional experience in management consulting, financial services, or a business or technology transformation role.


* As a Consultant, you will typically contribute to analysis and project delivery, while coordinating stakeholders within a workstream.
* As a Senior Consultant, you will typically lead workstreams, shape solutions, manage senior stakeholders, review deliverables, and guide junior colleagues.

**What you will do**

* Analyse complex business, operating model, regulatory, data, and technology challenges.
* Design practical solutions in collaboration with client stakeholders and Deloitte specialists.
* Support or lead workstreams from strategy and requirements through implementation and adoption.
* Translate business needs into clear requirements for technology and delivery teams.
* Develop evidence-based recommendations and present them clearly to senior stakeholders.
* Contribute to proposals, client relationships, and the continued development of our Financial Services capabilities.

**About the team**

You will join the Operations Transformation or Engineering team within Technology & Transformation. We combine deep industry knowledge with expertise in strategy, operations, technology, data, and change to help financial institutions deliver sustainable transformation.


Our team brings together colleagues with expertise across:


* Banking: payments, lending, savings, cards, financial crime, risk, compliance, and regulatory reporting.
* Capital markets: front-to-back trading, post-trade, treasury, finance transformation, and regulatory change.
* Asset and wealth management: operating model, product, platform, data, and regulatory transformation.
* Insurance: underwriting, claims, policy administration, personal and commercial products, and core-system implementation.
**Qualifications**
------------------

What we are looking for:


* A bachelor’s or master’s degree in a relevant field, such as business, engineering, economics, or information systems.
* Experience contributing to projects or workstreams that have delivered measurable business or operational change.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate complex information into practical recommendations.
* Confidence working with stakeholders across both business and technology functions.
* Professional fluency in Swedish and English, both written and spoken.
* Willingness to travel as required for client assignments.

**Experience that would be an advantage:**

* Experience in one or more of the Financial Services areas described above.
* Demonstrated interest or experience in business and IT transformations - project, programme, product, or requirements management.
* Business development.
* Regulatory, operating model, or process transformation.
* Change management and implementation of new ways of working.
* Business and technology transformation, including system implementation, cloud or system migration, vendor selection, data migration, testing, or agile delivery.

**How you work and as a person:**

* You build strong working relationships across diverse teams and client organisations.
* You take ownership of your work, manage priorities effectively, and deliver on commitments.
* You communicate complex ideas clearly, in a structured way and tailored to your audience.
* You are curious, actively seek feedback, and use it to continuously improve.
* You enjoy collaborating with others and are equally comfortable working independently when required.
* You are outgoing, collaborative and enjoy working as part of a team.
**Additional Information**
--------------------------

**What we offer**

* Varied assignments spanning design, implementation, and adoption.
* Structured development supported by a dedicated coach, formal learning, and regular on-the-job feedback.
* Access to Financial Services specialists and international teams across Deloitte’s global network.
* A collaborative and inclusive environment that values knowledge sharing and diverse perspectives.
* Opportunities to deepen your expertise, contribute to client development, and take on greater responsibility.
* Competitive compensation and benefits.

At Deloitte, we are committed to helping our employees grow and develop throughout their career. We offer a range of on-the-job learning experiences, formal development programs at Deloitte University, and access to a personal coach to support you in identifying and utilizing your strengths. We also provide the necessary training and resources for you to obtain various certifications to further advance in your career.


Our culture is built on collaboration and innovation. We value diverse perspectives and encourage our employees to think creatively to find the best solutions for our clients. We work hand-in-hand with our clients to understand their unique needs and to develop tailored solutions that drive growth and innovation. At Deloitte, you´ll have the chance to grow and succeed alongside like-minded professionals who share your passion.


**How to apply**

Please apply online. As part of your application, please submit:


* CV
* A short statement explaining your interest in the role and relevant industry experience (if any)
* University grades

*As a qualitative part of Deloitte's recruitment process, our final candidates undergo a background check, to increase awareness of our future employees, secure the working environment for our employees and meet regulatory requirements. The background check process is carried out in collaboration with To Find Out.* *https://tofindout.se/en/background-check/*

**Please submit your application as soon as possible, as we work with ongoing selection.**

At Deloitte, we value different skills, perspectives, and experiences, as it enables us to effectively solve complex challenges for our clients. We encourage you to apply for the position if you believe your skills can contribute to our team’s success.


**Questions?**

If you have any questions regarding the role or the application process, please contact Anna Taube, Manager Talent Acquisition, at ataube@deloitte.se .


**We are looking forward to your application!**

**What impact will you make?**

Every day, your work will make an impact that matters, while you thrive in a dynamic culture of inclusion, collaboration and high performance. We do not just aspire to make solutions. We wish to create an impact that makes a positive and crucial difference for the people around us, our clients and our society. Deloitte is where you’ll find unlimited opportunities to succeed and realize your full potential.


For further information on Deloitte, please visit www.deloitte.se


**What impact will you make?**

På Deloitte gör ditt arbete en meningsfull skillnad, varje dag, medan du växer i en inkluderande företagskultur av samarbete och hög prestation. Utöver att skapa lösningar strävar vi efter att göra en positiv och avgörande skillnad för andra i vår omgivning, våra klienter och samhället. På Deloitte hittar du tidigare dolda möjligheter att lyckas och inser din fulla potential.

title: Learning Experience Designer to Tech Academy
description:
**Job Description** **ABOUT TECH ACADEMY**  

  

Tech Academy exists to empower H&M Tech colleagues to build the skills they need to deliver on business needs. By strengthening key tech capabilities and creating a strong learning culture, we help make technology a competitive advantage for H&M.  

  

We do this through two main offerings: Academy Initiatives, leadership-sponsored programs that build business-critical skills at scale and Explore & Learn, platforms, events and communities that support employees’ own development  

  

**JOB DESCRIPTION**


As Learning Experience Designer, you’ll play an important role in shaping how H&M Tech colleagues learn and build new capabilities. You’ll turn Tech Academy’s priorities into engaging learning experiences that build real capability and make a difference to business results.  

  

In this role, you will turn Tech Academy’s priorities into well-designed, engaging learning experiences that make a real difference to how H&M Tech colleagues deliver business results. You will work closely with the Tech Academy team, Tech Centers, Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) and the People organization to support upskilling within prioritized skill areas.

**WHAT YOU’LL DO**  

  

This is a hands-on role for a person who thrives in a fast-paced, collaborative environment and enjoys turning complex technical knowledge into engaging, learner-centered experiences that build real skills through practice.  

  

Key responsibilities include:

* Analyze tech upskilling and performance needs, translating them into clear learning objectives and effective learning experiences.
* Lead the design of engaging, interactive learning experiences, from scenario-based digital learning to workshops and micro-learning, in collaboration with SMEs and external partners.
* Partner with and coach SMEs to translate their experience into effective learning experiences.
* Prototype and pilot learning experiences with learners, and plan, facilitate and deliver tech-focused learning events.
* Design and manage the Tech Academy channel in our Learning Experience Platform (LXP), creating structured learning journeys based on roles and skills.
* Design content and activities for communities of practice and learning campaigns that keep colleagues engaged and make offerings easy to find.
* Set clear KPIs, evaluate the effectiveness and impact of learning initiatives and use learner feedback and data to continuously improve them.
* Partner with external learning providers and tech partners, such as Microsoft and Google Cloud, to integrate their expertise into learning experiences.
* Explore and apply AI-enabled ways of designing, building and delivering learning where they improve the learner experience

**WHO YOU ARE**  

  

You’re a learner-centered designer who understands how great learning experiences can build skills and create business impact. You enjoy working collaboratively in a large, complex organisation and are comfortable navigating ambiguity.


You communicate confidently with both technical and non-technical audiences and can advise stakeholders on how people learn best. You’re also comfortable taking ownership and bringing an idea from an identified learning need through to a finished experience.

*We are looking for people with...*

* 7+ years of proven experience in learning experience design (instructional design, needs analysis, learning journey design, evaluation), backed by a portfolio and grounded in learning science, such as adult learning theory, plus facilitation and delivery experience (training, coaching, mentoring)
* Experience designing interactive learning in a tech environment, translating technical content into hands-on experiences with meaningful practice, such as scenarios and simulations, ideally going beyond linear, click-through eLearning
* Hands-on experience with rapid authoring tools (e.g., Articulate 360, or similar) and LXP systems (e.g., EdCast, or similar) and designing learning experiences within them
* Experience using learner feedback and data to evaluate and improve learning, ideally including learning analytics and impact measurement
* Strong project management and stakeholder collaboration skills, with experience leading complex initiatives from early idea to finished learning experience
* Fluency in English, written and spoken, and experience working in global, complex matrix organizations
* Experience using AI as an enabler in learning design is an advantage

**ADDITIONAL INFORMATION**

**This is a permanent position based from our Head Office in Marievik, Stockholm**. The role is office-based, with a general expectation of being onsite four days a week. If this sounds like an opportunity for you, we’d be happy to hear from you. **Please submit you CV in English and a portfolio at your earliest availability.**  



**WHO WE ARE**


H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.


We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together we want to use our power, our scale and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future. Read more about us here

**JOIN US**


Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it is our people who make us who we are.


Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here.

*H&M Group is committed to creating a Diverse & Inclusive environment and we are actively looking for qualified candidates irrespective of race, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, national origin, disability or age*

title: Staff Data Scientist
description:
Join Truecaller – The place where innovation meets impact! Truecaller's mission is to build trust in communication by making it safer, smarter, and more efficient. Born in Sweden, trusted by the world, and here’s why we stand out: We are trusted by over 500 million active users every month across 190+ countries We identify over 15 billion calls daily, helping users avoid spam and scams We are powered by a team of 400+ employees from 45+ nationalities We always look for people who take initiative, own their work, and keep raising the bar. An entrepreneurial mindset matters here, especially when it turns bold ideas into real actions.
  
  

We stay collaborative and focused, always searching for smarter paths forward. If you want to make an impact and grow with a team that inspires millions, you’ll fit right in. The role You will lead the Decisioning squad as its most senior data scientist: data scientists, ML engineers, and backend engineers across Stockholm and India. This is a hands-on leadership role.
  
  

You will still write models, run the offline evaluations, and read the experiment results yourself. What you'll do: Own the modelling roadmap for decisioning - conversion prediction, ranking, campaign selection and bidding - and agree it with product and engineering. Design, build and run production models end to end, from problem framing and features through offline evaluation, A/B tests and monitoring. Evolve the contextual bandit from choosing which campaign to show to setting a per-request bid, with exploration, off-policy evaluation and safe rollout built in.
  
  

**Keep model scores honest:** calibration per campaign and placement, and a clear link between offline metrics and the revenue and conversions advertisers actually see. Set the bar for experimentation in the squad: every model change ships with a holdout, an agreed success metric and a clear ship or kill rule. Lead the squad: set the technical direction, review designs and code, run the prioritisation, and grow the data scientists, engineers and interns around you. You are accountable for what the squad ships, not only for your own work.
  
  

Write the RFCs and decision records the group works from, and present results and trade-offs to product, commercial and executive leadership. Work with backend and data engineering on serving latency, feature pipelines and data quality, so models run reliably at very high throughput. Raise the data science practice across Revenue Intelligence and the wider discipline through reviews, shared methods and mentoring. What you bring in: 7+ years in data science or applied machine learning, including several years owning models in production that real revenue depends on.
  
  

Depth in ranking, recommendation or conversion prediction at scale - multi-task learning, deep learning and gradient-boosted models, and calibration. Hands-on experience with online learning or decision systems, such as contextual bandits, exploration strategies and off-policy evaluation. Strong experimentation skills: A/B test design, power, causal reasoning, and telling a real lift from noise. Expert Python and SQL, with a modern deep learning framework (TensorFlow/Keras or PyTorch) and a cloud warehouse at real scale.
  
  

We run on GCP and BigQuery; equivalent depth on another stack transfers. Technical leadership of a team: setting direction, reviewing other people's work, and raising the quality of the people around you. Strong written English. You will write the RFCs, evaluation reports and design docs, and they will be read by people who were not in the room.
  
  

Comfort operating across Sweden and India time zones. It will be great if you also have: Ad tech experience - real-time bidding, auctions, pacing, attribution or campaign delivery. Experience with the India digital advertising market and performance advertisers. An MSc or PhD in computer science, statistics, mathematics or a related field.
  
  

Experience taking models to low-latency serving, and the MLOps around it: model registries, monitoring and automated retraining. Exposure to privacy-constrained modelling, such as GDPR and India's DPDP Act. Experience applying LLMs to modelling or analysis work. What we offer: We support growth through learning resources, leadership programs, mentoring, and real hands-on work.
  
  

People can move between teams and projects to build new skills and keep things interesting. We offer clear internal mobility and a transparent path for progression, with leaders who stay involved and provide guidance throughout the year. In addition, you will benefit from: A comprehensive compensation package: We offer a competitive salary, 30 days of paid vacation, private health insurance, parental leave top-up, pension, and wellness contributions. Modern tools to do your best work: Choose your preferred computer and phone within our budget, so you can work comfortably and efficiently.
  
  

**A people-focused office culture:** We value in-person collaboration and follow an office-first model, with some flexibility. Our offices offer a vibrant environment with opportunities to learn, connect, and recharge, from breakfast, lunch, and well-stocked snack stations and quiet spaces to team activities such as movie nights, tech meetups, and cultural events. There's something for everyone. Truecaller’s “Lab Days” offer a space for imagination: 5 times per year for 3 days, where everyone steps away from their normal tasks to explore new, bold ideas and build things they’ve always wanted to.
  
  

It’s a space where curiosity leads the way, and prototypes take shape. Some concepts even make it into production, and a few have grown into real features used by millions today. Lab Days allow you to be creative, learn fast, and help shape Truecaller's future. Come as you are: Truecaller is committed to building a diverse and inclusive team.
  
  

We believe that a wide range of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences strengthens our products and our culture. No matter where you're from, what language you speak, or how you identify, we value what makes you unique and would love to get to know you.

What you’ll do Cloud and architecture security. Run security architecture reviews and threat modelling. Assess our AWS and GCP environments (IAM, networking, storage, databases, secrets, logging), set requirements and validate builds. SDLC and application security.
  
  

Embed IaC scanning, SAST, DAST, SCA and secret scanning into CI/CD. Review web and API security against OWASP ASVS/Top 10, including OAuth 2.0, SAML and OIDC. AI security. Threat-model and review AI features, LLM integrations, agents and connectors against OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications and OWASP AI Exchange.

Own the end-to-end process across apps, cloud and endpoints. Prioritise by attack path and asset context, driving pentest findings and risk exceptions to verified closure.
  
  

Detection and incident response. Define security telemetry, tune SIEM detections against MITRE ATT&CK and lead incident triage, containment and post-incident reviews. ISMS and audits. Run ISO 27001 and SOC 2 day to day.

Assess third-party risk at onboarding and renewal, complete customer security questionnaires and keep our Trust Centre current. ✅ What we’re looking for Several years of hands-on security experience in a multi-tenant SaaS company across cloud security engineering and GRC.
  
  

Hands-on experience with AWS or GCP and working knowledge of the other (IAM, networking, workload security, KMS, audit logging). Detection engineering with SIEM and MITRE ATT&CK, plus experience leading incidents and writing post-incident reviews. Ability to read code and Terraform, write automation in Python, Bash or PowerShell, and query telemetry via SIEM or SQL. You assess risk by material exposure and real exploitability, explaining why a critical tool score is a medium for us. Ownership. You drive findings and risk exceptions through to verified closure. Clear communication.

title: Director Of Tech Security
description:
Vi är Strawberry. Ett växande universum med hundratals hotell, restauranger, spa och upplevelser i hela Norden, Litauen och på Färöarna. Här ryms urbana Comfort Hotel™, varma Quality Hotel™, stilfulla Clarion Hotel®, hemtrevliga Home Hotel och vägnära Stopover – tillsammans med en stor samling unika och fristående hotell. På sina hotellvistelser samlar våra gäster dessutom Spenn – flexibla poäng att använda till nya upplevelser. Bakom allt står tiotusentals människor från hela världen, med energi, mod och entusiasm.
At Strawberry, we're not just a hotel company – we're building a universe of experiences. We're transforming the hospitality landscape through innovation and technology, and as we scale our cloud architecture, distributed access, and AI-driven capabilities across more than 250 properties and hundreds of distinct operating entities, security is at the very core of enabling safe, continuous innovation.

  

Are you ready to lead Strawberry’s cybersecurity and information security strategy into the AI era? At Strawberry, we're creating a better world with Energy, Courage, and Excitement, and we're looking for a strategic yet hands-on leader to safeguard our digital future.

  

As our Director of Tech Security, reporting to the VP Tech Strategy and Architecture, you will serve as the central point of responsibility for cyber and information security across Strawberry. Combining strategic leadership, team management, architectural governance, and operational oversight, you will protect our digital infrastructure, platforms, and services against evolving threats – ensuring that security acts as an enabler for innovation, speed, and business agility rather than a bottleneck.


(Note: Physical security, paper documentation, and non-digital environments fall outside the scope of this role).

 **What You'll Do:**

* Set Strategy & Governance: Define Strawberry’s cybersecurity and information security strategy, technical standards, and protective controls – working closely with the Data Protection Officer (DPO), Legal, and business leads to ensure regulatory compliance (GDPR, PCI, EU AI Act) while driving proactive security awareness.
* Lead Team & Security Operations: Lead the internal security team and manage external partners to ensure effective threat detection, vulnerability management, Identity and Access Management (IAM), and continuous monitoring across our security stack.
* Own Incident Management: Own incident response processes and take the operational lead during major security incidents and breaches – coordinating response efforts, stakeholder communication, and post-incident remediation alongside external specialists and the DPO.
* Pioneer AI & Agentic Security: Lead the security roadmap for AI and autonomous agents, defining guardrails for AI/MCP gateways, token exchange (On-Behalf-Of access), and PII protection so that agents operate strictly within Zero Trust principles and user permissions.
* Drive Automation & Scale: Champion automation and agentic workflows across core service platforms to streamline ticket handling, documentation, playbooks, and compliance follow-up.
* Embed Security-by-Design & Resilience: Partner with solution architects, product owners, and technical leadership to conduct architectural security reviews across cloud, SaaS, data flows, and vendors, while ensuring Disaster Recovery (DR) and Business Continuity (BCP) capabilities are regularly tested and maintained.
* Act as a Trusted Advisor: Bridge business needs and technical execution across Tech, Finance, Legal, HR, and Analytics – balancing long-term strategic priorities with pragmatic, preventive risk mitigation.

 **What You'll Bring:**

* Strategic & Operational Leadership: Several years of experience leading security teams or specialists, with a proven ability to build structure, drive organizational change, and manage operations in a complex, decentralized environment.
* Business-Aligned Security Mindset: A strong ability to balance security requirements with commercial priorities and agility, translating complex technical risks into clear guidance for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Cross-Functional Influence: Strong interpersonal and influencing skills, with the confidence to partner effectively with executive leadership, the DPO, architects, product teams, and external vendors.
* Passion for Modern Tech & AI: A genuine interest in how modern cloud-based and AI-driven architectures reshape the threat landscape – and how smart security unlocks business value.

 **What You'll Need:**

* Educational Background: A bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, engineering, information security, or a related field – or a background in business, legal, or risk management paired with demonstrated deep technical insight.
* Frameworks & Regulations: Solid understanding of risk management principles, cybersecurity frameworks, and regulatory standards including GDPR, PCI, and the EU AI Act.
* Cloud, Identity & SOC Expertise: Deep experience with Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM), modern endpoint/SOC ecosystems, and Identity and Access Management (IAM, federation, Zero Trust, and token propagation).
* AI & API Architecture Security: Hands-on familiarity with securing APIs, cloud-native architectures, and emerging AI/agentic ecosystems (such as gateway controls, token exchange, and data/PII protection).
* Automation Mindset: Experience streamlining and automating security operations, playbooks, and compliance workflows.

 **What We Offer:**

* Real Impact: Be at the center of Strawberry’s digital and AI transformation, shaping how security enables growth across 250+ hotels.
* Empowerment: Work in a flat, fast-moving organization built on trust, autonomy, and the freedom to make a real difference.
* Growth & Development: Access continuous professional development to sharpen your skills and grow your leadership career.
* Fun & Community: Enjoy a vibrant, inclusive work environment with plenty of social events and team-building activities.
* Fantastic Perks: Benefit from great employee discounts, including staff and friends & family rates across all Strawberry hotels.
* Flexible Work: Enjoy the best of both worlds with our hybrid model, with three days of in-person collaboration at our HQ in Stockholm or Oslo.

  

We do not offer remote positions; candidates must be located in or willing to relocate to Stockholm or Oslo.

 **Ready to shape the future of hospitality? Apply today – interviews are ongoing!**

  

Disclaimer: This role description outlines the primary responsibilities of the position. The role may evolve over time, and additional projects or tasks may be added or adjusted by mutual agreement.

**About the Role**

As a Process and Journey Manager, you’ll improve customer journeys and processes across digital channels, with a focus on lifecycle management and data driven journey orchestration with marketing automation capabilities and digital platforms.


You’ll design end-to-end customer journeys and processes, translate customer and business needs into clear requirements, and drive delivery with business and technology specialists. title: Engineer, PEG AI and Machine Learning Engineering
description:
WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORK
  
  

We are proud to be consistently recognised as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top-ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times.
  
  

Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  

WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH
  
  

As the premier consulting partner for the private equity industry, Bain's PEG boasts a global practice that is over three times larger than any competitor. Our network of over 1,000 professionals supports private equity and institutional investor clients through every stage of the investment life cycle, from deal generation and due diligence to portfolio value creation and exit planning.
  
  

Bain & Company is developing a suite of cutting-edge data and software solutions designed to revolutionise how the private equity industry uses data for investment insights and decision-making.
  
  

The PEG Innovation team's mission is to create analytical solutions for Bain clients, teams, and the broader institutional investor space using proprietary software and data products. This includes the development, commercialisation, and daily management of Bain's proprietary datasets, data, and software businesses.
  
  

WHERE YOU’LL FIT WITHIN THE TEAM
  
  

AI/ML Engineers on the Diligence Platform build and maintain the data, feature, and retrieval pipelines that power production RAG and ML systems. You work under the guidance of Senior ML Engineers and the Engineering Manager to implement and operate components of the ingestion, embedding, and retrieval stack, ship well-tested production code, and grow your ownership of these systems over time. You partner with Data Engineers, Data Scientists, and the Agent / AI squad on defined pieces of larger pipelines and RAG workstreams, and you build the habits, tooling fluency, and production judgment expected of a Senior ML Engineer. This is a hands-on, growth-oriented engineering role: you are expected to ship reliable, observable code from your first weeks, and to take on increasing ownership as your track record builds.
  
  

WHAT YOU’LL DO
  
  

Core ML and Data Pipeline Engineering (65%)
  
  

* Implement and maintain components of production data and ML pipelines: ingestion jobs, feature and embedding pipelines, and Celery-based workers, under the direction of senior engineers.
* Build and support pieces of the RAG and retrieval stack: chunking, embedding calls, indexing into pg-vector, and basic retrieval and re-ranking logic, following established patterns.
* Write production-quality Python: type hints, tests, and linting to the team's standards, with code reviewed by senior engineers before merge.
* Instrument the pipelines and services you own with structured logs and metrics, and help build the dashboards and alerts that make issues visible.
* Reproduce, triage, and fix bugs in pipeline and serving code, escalating ambiguous or high-severity issues to senior engineers.


Collaboration and Support (25%)
  
  

* Partner with Data Engineers, Data Scientists, and the Agent / AI squad on defined tasks within larger pipeline, retrieval, and evaluation workstreams.
* Contribute test cases and sample data to evaluation harnesses and golden datasets, under the direction of senior engineers.
* Participate in design reviews and code reviews, both as reviewer and reviewee, building judgment about production trade-offs.
* Keep runbooks, READMEs, and pipeline documentation current as you build and change the systems you touch.


**Other (10%):**  

* Use AI coding assistants to accelerate scaffolding and boilerplate, and review generated code against team standards before committing.
* Use LLMs to draft documentation and status notes; validate and refine outputs before sharing them.
* Take on interviewing and hiring-loop participation as your experience grows.


ABOUT YOU
  
  

**Education and Work Experience:**  

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Machine Learning, Data Science, Statistics, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
* 2+ years of experience building software, data, or ML systems, ideally including some exposure to production pipelines or services.
* Exposure to model deployment, serving, or monitoring is a plus.
* Experience working with structured feedback and code review, and a track record of improving code quality over time.
* Experience collaborating with Data Engineers, Data Scientists, or the Agent / AI squad to ship features that depend on retrieval or ML outputs.
* Comfort with Python as a primary language; exposure to a modern cloud environment (Databricks, Azure, or AWS) is a plus.
* Demonstrated ability to take a well-scoped task from specification to a tested, reviewed implementation with limited supervision.


**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:**  

ML engineering / LLMOps
  
  

* Working knowledge of Python for data and ML workloads: type hints, Pydantic, pytest, Ruff, with production-quality pipeline and serving code that would pass a code review.
* Familiarity with MLflow concepts: experiment tracking, model registry, and promotion workflows.
* Exposure to LLMOps concepts: prompt versioning, model gateways (e.g., Portkey), and inference orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, or equivalent).
* Good understanding of model-serving concepts: latency, throughput, and batching, even without direct production ownership yet.
* RAG pipeline building blocks: chunking strategies, embeddings, and vector stores such as pgvector; able to contribute to indexing and retrieval jobs under senior guidance.
* Understanding of model and pipeline evaluation basics: what a golden dataset is, and why regression gates matter in CI.
* Docker: comfortable containerising pipeline or serving code and running it locally for testing.
* Git: confident with PR-based workflows.


Generative AI and agentic systems
  
  

* Contributes to inference and retrieval services that feed agent workflows as structured tool responses.
* Supports RAG quality work: helps build and run recall and precision checks against defined benchmarks.
* Exposure to LLM-as-judge evaluation patterns, even if applied under senior-engineer direction.


General
  
  

* Treats testing, observability, and documentation as part of the job, not an afterthought, even on smaller tasks.
* Raises questions and surfaces uncertainty early rather than guessing silently on ambiguous requirements.
* Uses AI tooling to move faster, and reviews all generated code and documentation critically before it enters the codebase.
* Communicates clearly with teammates about progress, blockers, and trade-offs; asks for help early.

title: Senior Embedded Software/Systems Engineer – medicinteknik, Uppsala
description:
Vår kund, ett internationellt medicinteknikbolag i Uppsala, söker en erfaren embedded-utvecklare som ska utveckla, förvalta och förbättra kundens produkter. Rollen omfattar embedded-mjukvaruutveckling, systemintegration och praktisk felsökning över hela produkten: från hårdvarunära mjukvara och realtidsoperativsystem till nätverk och ett webbaserat användargränssnitt.  

  

**Arbetsuppgifter**  

* Utveckla ny funktionalitet i C och C++, med fokus på prestanda, minnesanvändning och tillförlitlighet
* Förvalta och vidareutveckla befintlig kod (legacy) utan att påverka befintlig funktionalitet
* Utveckla på etablerade realtidsplattformar: tasks, schemaläggning, synkronisering och kommunikation mellan mjukvarukomponenter
* Felsöka över hela systemet (mjukvara, OS, nätverk och hårdvara) med hjälp av loggar, debugverktyg och mätningar
* Implementera och felsöka funktionalitet i ett befintligt webbgränssnitt (HTML, CSS, JavaScript) samt kommunikationen mellan webbläsare och enhet
* Ta fram reproducerbara testfall, genomföra integrationstester och dokumentera resultat
* Delta i kodgranskningar, hantera ändringar i Git och stötta integration och firmware-releaser

  

**Skall-krav**  

* Gedigen erfarenhet av C och C++ på system med begränsat minne och begränsad processorkraft, inklusive äldre kodbaser (C++03/C++11)
* Erfarenhet av realtidsoperativsystem som VxWorks, FreeRTOS, QNX eller liknande, och god förståelse för trådar, mutexar, semaforer och vanliga concurrency-problem
* Goda Linux-kunskaper: kommandorad, fjärråtkomst, processhantering, byggmiljöer och felsökning
* Van Git-användare: branching, merging, rebasing, konfliktlösning och kodgranskning
* God förståelse för nätverk: TCP/IP, UDP, HTTP/HTTPS och grundläggande nätverksfelsökning
* Praktisk erfarenhet av hårdvarufelsökning med oscilloskop, multimeter och seriella debugverktyg
* Erfarenhet av embedded-gränssnitt som UART, SPI, I²C och Ethernet
* Tillräckliga webbkunskaper för att implementera och felsöka ändringar i ett befintligt webbgränssnitt
* Erfarenhet av byggverktyg och toolchains som Make, CMake och korskompileringsmiljöer

  

**Meriterande**  

* Mjukvaruverifiering, testdokumentation och spårbarhet mellan testresultat och krav
* Firmware-paketering, uppgraderingar, rollback och recovery
* Release management och kompatibilitet mellan mjukvarukomponenter
* Nätverksanalysverktyg som Wireshark eller tcpdump
* CAN-kommunikation

  

**Personliga egenskaper**  

Vi söker dig som är analytisk och praktisk och som tar ägarskap för tekniska problem. Du arbetar självständigt men samarbetar väl med andra, och du kommunicerar dina slutsatser tydligt. Du felsöker systematiskt genom att pröva antaganden och låta fakta styra. Du trivs med legacy-system och går gärna utanför ditt eget expertområde för att hitta orsaken till ett problem. Du prioriterar lösningar som är tillförlitliga, begripliga och underhållbara.  

  

**Villkor**  

* Det offererande bolaget ska vara godkänt för F-skatt i Sverige
* Ort: Uppsala
* På plats: hybrid, tre dagar på plats
* Startdatum: december/januari
* Uppdragslängd: initialt sex månader med möjlighet till förlängning
* Omfattning: 100%
* Sista svarsdag: 30 november

  

**Så här svarar du**  

Skicka följande per kandidat:  

1. Uppdaterat CV på engelska  

2. Tillgänglighet: möjligt startdatum och omfattning  

3. En kort motivering (max ca 150 ord) om hur kandidaten uppfyller skall-kraven, särskilt C/C++, RTOS och Linux  

  

Vi återkommer endast till kandidater som uppfyller skall-kraven och som offereras av ett bolag godkänt för F-skatt.
